base32-encoder-decoder.name: Base32 Encoder / Decoder
base32-encoder-decoder.description: Encode or decode UTF-8 text and hexadecimal bytes using RFC 4648 Base32 or Base32hex locally.

meta.title: Base32 Encoder / Decoder
meta.description: Encode or decode UTF-8 text and hexadecimal bytes using RFC 4648 Base32 or Base32hex locally.
meta.keywords: Base32 Encoder / Decoder, Base32, Base32hex, RFC 4648, UTF-8, hex, TOTP

base32.representationHint: Used as the input when encoding and the output when decoding. Hex accepts pairs of digits and ASCII whitespace, without 0x prefixes.
base32.hint: Up to {limit} UTF-16 code units. Text whitespace is preserved; Base32 and hex ignore ASCII whitespace.
base32.emptyResult: Enter data and convert it to see the result.
base32.rules: RFC 4648 only; Crockford Base32 is not supported. Decode accepts lowercase and optional padding, validates padding and unused bits, and rejects invalid UTF-8 in text mode. Encoding is reversible and provides no encryption.
base32.inputLimit: Use at most {limit} UTF-16 code units.
base32.invalidHex: Enter complete hexadecimal byte pairs (00–ff), without prefixes or separators other than ASCII whitespace.
base32.invalidUnicode: The text contains an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate. Replace the invalid character.
base32.invalidCharacters: The input contains characters outside the selected Base32 alphabet.
base32.invalidPadding: Invalid = padding. Padding must be at the end and have the exact RFC 4648 length.
base32.invalidLength: Invalid Base32 length. The number of data symbols modulo 8 must be 0, 2, 4, 5 or 7.
base32.nonZeroBits: Unused trailing bits must be zero. This is not a canonical Base32 encoding.
base32.invalidUtf8: Decoded bytes are not valid UTF-8. Select hexadecimal bytes to inspect binary data.
